# Assets and their licenses

Rule for this project: every asset is CC0 or open source with no restriction on reuse. Nothing here
is downloaded art, a game asset pack or a proprietary font.

## Generated by this repository (ours; no third-party content)

| asset | made by |
|---|---|
| `sim/assets/x500.urdf` (physics model: mass, inertia, rotor positions, thrust constants as numbers) | written by hand from the parameter values of PX4's model |
| `sim/assets/x500_render*.urdf` | `sim/assets/make_x500_render_urdf.py` |
| `sim/assets/generated/checker.png` (ground texture of the flight renders) | `sim/render_flight.py` (`ground`) |
| propeller motion blur in the renders | `sim/render_flight.py` (`draw_props`), computed per pixel |
| everything under `sim/world/assets/` (gorge terrain, rock and vegetation textures, boulders, firebrands) | the scripts in `sim/world/`, from a seed; see `sim/world/ASSETS.md` |

## Third-party

| asset | origin | license | conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sim/assets/x500_meshes/*` (X500 frame, motor and propeller meshes, `CF.png`) | PX4-gazebo-models, `models/x500_base/meshes` | BSD 3-Clause (`sim/assets/x500_meshes/LICENSE`) | keep the copyright notice; no endorsement. Used for drawing only |
| CF2X model and mesh (`cf2x.urdf`, `cf2.dae`), used from the installed package, not copied | gym-pybullet-drones | MIT | keep the notice |
| text in rendered images | DejaVu Sans, as shipped with Matplotlib | Bitstream Vera / DejaVu license (free, redistributable) | none on rendered output |

Not used: `pybullet_data` (PyBullet's bundled models and textures), system fonts.

## Software the simulation runs on

PyBullet (zlib), gym-pybullet-drones (MIT), NumPy (BSD 3-Clause), Pillow (MIT-CMU), Matplotlib
(PSF-style), Lean 4 and Mathlib (Apache 2.0), FloatLib (MIT), DynamicalSystems (Apache 2.0).
